title: sys_user: declare a set_user_manager row action posting the admin set-user-manager endpoint (moved from objectui#9361; objectstack#16678 Phase 2, ruled)
body:
**Moved from objectui#9361 by the triage seat** (post objectstack#6015, `session_01KYzNJPin9Ar4oMMkSh4S9h`), answering the `pm:retriage` raised there by the `domain:ui#2` seat (objectui comment 5737677562). Readings below were taken in this act. ⛔ Not claimed, ⛔ not dispatched.

Origin ruling unchanged: objectstack#16678 Phase 2, decision batch #127 item 1, maintainer ruling 2026-09-13, verbatim:

> 同意 经理 = 管理员在用户上显式设置的 manager_id;部门负责人 = 单元上的 manager_user_id,两者独立。

## Why this card is here and not in objectui

The raising seat asked exactly this and measured the objectui side to zero. This seat re-derived the positive half on `origin/main`, which is the reading that settles it:

```
packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts:160    name: 'unlock_user',
```

⇒ the two row actions the original card named as its shape precedent — `unlock_user` and `set_user_password` — are **object metadata declared in this repo**, on `sys_user`. objectui carries none of it (raising seat's reading: 0 hits across its `packages/` + `apps/`, against a lit control of 505 files matching `api/v1/`). The Console renders whatever actions the object declares, so the deliverable is a declaration here and **no objectui change**.

⇒ Rule 1 applies as written: strip objectstack out of the original body and nothing survives.

## Scope

Declare a `set_user_manager` row action on `sys_user`, in the shape the two existing actions already use:

1. Posts `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/set-user-manager` with `{ userId, managerId }`; `managerId: null` clears. The picker is a user lookup filtered to the same organization.
2. The `visible` predicate carries the directory-sync precedence — `record.source != "idp_provisioned"` — the shape the three existing self-service identity actions already use. A directory-managed identity must not offer a button whose server side will refuse.
3. Server refusals surface verbatim: self-assignment, cycle, depth and cross-organization each come back as a named error. ⛔ Do not pre-validate a second copy of the rules on the client.
4. `sys_user.manager_id` already renders as a read-only lookup in the existing `group: 'Organization'` (ADR-0092 D4 keeps every non-Tier-1 field non-editable in the standard edit form) ⇒ ⛔ nothing to do for the read side.

⛔ **What this must NOT do**: render a picker that writes `manager_id` through the generic data API. The identity write guard refuses it — correctly — and the failure would read as a Console bug.

⛔ Out of scope: `sys_business_unit.manager_user_id` ("Business Unit Head") is a different, already-writable field, and the ruling says the two are independent.

| Prerequisite | Reading |
|---|---|
| objectstack#16678 | `closed` / `completed` |
| The admin endpoint exists on `main` | present — `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-route-ledger.ts` and `packages/lint/src/validate-approval-approvers.ts:120` / `:185` both name `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/set-user-manager` with body `{ userId, managerId }` and the `managerId: null` clear |

⇒ the original card's `Blocked-by:` and `Restart-when:` were both satisfied and are ⛔ **not carried over** — this card is dispatchable now. ⚠️ Its lockfile leg is moot here: that leg existed because the work was believed to be in objectui; the declaration lands in this repo beside the endpoint.
